claims.summary: For every p > 19 and positive p-divisible L, the full elliptic paired-character source with polynomial coordinate F_L plus G_3*T^L is generically Hasse-normal. Hence original dimension nine is normal for d >= 7 with 32d-97 congruent to 1 modulo p, and dimension ten for d >= 8 with 64d-225 congruent to 1 modulo p. Eleven residual bulk profiles and unproved low-degree complements remain.
claims.assessment: Working computer-assisted proof via twelve complete first-source cuts and six second-source cuts, exact symbolic row-operation certificates, independent positive-degree source extraction and all seven large-prime denominator repairs. The changed boundary at 997 has the explicit two-square determinant 5440, nonzero modulo 997; other primes give a consecutive rational endpoint. Full saturation and the stronger even-transfer premise are retained.
claims.rationale: Uniform route progress on one entire remaining normality residue family. This is a source-preserving extension with an explicitly repaired exceptional boundary, not evidence that all profiles share a power pattern.
claims.next_action: Test the actual residue-two source and retain any exceptional-prime marked blocks.
